name: Tanados UI
description: Tanados UI rebrands Jellyfin Web automatically with the Tanados logo/colors and adds the enhanced MonWUI/JMSFusion experience layer.
overview: Tanados-branded Jellyfin Web UI upgrade with automatic logo replacement, purple/gold theme accents, cinematic sliders, enhanced details, playback, profiles, watchlist, and settings.

versions.changelog:
v2.8.1.0

Changes:
- Added automatic Tanados logo replacement for Jellyfin Web header, splash/login logo, image logos, document title, and favicons
- Added Tanados branding CSS loaded by the plugin injection block without manual Custom CSS
- Added Tanados purple/gold accent overrides to reduce the original green/teal styling
- Added optimized Tanados logo and favicon assets under /slider/src/images
- Updated visible plugin naming to Tanados UI

Notes:
- Restart Jellyfin after installing or updating
- Perform a hard browser refresh (Ctrl + F5) after updating
- Native Jellyfin apps may not use server-side web branding; this targets Jellyfin Web loaded from your server
